result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: upon termination or expiration, Kubient must provide requested transition assistance for up to six months at then-current rates, return Customer data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, delete it thereafter, and certify deletion in writing. The additions are limited to the required exit obligations and preserve the existing termination consequences. Drafting is substantively clear, though the list formatting and punctuation should be cleaned up, particularly the placement of “and” in subsection (iv) and the run-on numbering of subsections (v) and (vi).
